feeds.title: Leadership Now Blog
feeds.description: Leading Blog encourages people to lead from where they are. We highlight issues of interest to leaders and have links to sources of information on the web. More than book reviews, the commentary points to the fundamentals of leadership that will help you to meet today's leadership challenges.

feeds.title: Ask a Manager
feeds.description: Ask A Manager by Allison Green discusses all the usual questions and doubts regarding Work Behaviour, Coordination between Bosses and Co-workers, How to navigate the difficult areas in Corporate, and more insightful stuff for women. Covered topics include internships, Job searches Hiring advice, and Boss-employee relations.

feeds.title: The Chief Happiness Officer Blog
feeds.description: Alexander is the founder and Chief Happiness Officer of Woohoo inc and one of the world's leading experts on happiness at work. He is an author and speaker, presenting and conducting workshops on happiness at work at businesses and conferences in over 30 countries.

feeds.title: Leadership Freak Blog
feeds.description: Dan Rockwell is a Management expert and currently coaches leaders, consults with organizations, and delivers corporate and community presentations. His blog Leadership blog explains and presents critical leadership skills and ideas to readers who want to make a difference and lead their lives.

feeds.title: Tanveer Naseer Blog
feeds.description: Tanveer Naseer is an internationally acclaimed keynote speaker and award-winning leadership writer. His blog discusses the challenges and opportunities leaders face including boosting workforce productivity, managing employee health, and adapting to dynamic corporate conditions. Read more posts for richer insights.

feeds.title: John Maxwell Blog
feeds.description: The John Maxwell Company compels corporate leaders and consumers to inspire, challenge, and equip organizations to live out leadership and reach their potential. This blog is packed full of ideas, and resources to help potential leaders come forwards and realize their full set of leadership skills.

feeds.title: Full Focus Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog for the latest insights and strategies for goal achievement. Full Focus is a performance coaching company based in downtown Franklin, TN. We equip goal-minded individuals, business owners, and leaders of the world's largest companies with the resources they need to accelerate their performance.

feeds.title: Penelope Trunk Careers
feeds.description: Start-up Founder and Writer Penelope Trunk document her Career Path, New ideas, Career advice, and Business Management tips for young professionals in this blog. Read personal stories, gossip, smart, and observations on a myriad of conversational topics.

feeds.title: Suzi McAlpine
feeds.description: Suzi McAlpine's blog - The Leader's Digest, talks about trending leadership skills and how to ignite better leadership in individuals, teams, and organizations. Suzi works alongside CEOs, managers, and executives to facilitate clarity, direction, and optimal performance.
